import copy,json
from work import evaluate
P={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
def req(**c): return {'claim':'x','conditions':c}
def ev(source,value,conditions=None,**kw):
 d={'source':source,'claim':'x','value':value,'conditions':conditions if conditions is not None else {'a':1,'b':2},'verified':True}; d.update(kw); return d
cases=[
 ('missing',req(a=1),[],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']}),
 ('none',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('z',1,{'a':1,'b':3})],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),
 ('supersede',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('old',1),ev('new',2,supersedes=['old'])],P,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}),
 ('conflict',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('b',{'q':1}),ev('a',{'q':2})],P,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']}),
 ('canonical',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('b',{'z':2,'a':1}),ev('a',{'a':1,'z':2})],P,{'status':'supported','value':{'z':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]}),
 ('false',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('f',False)],P,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]}),
 ('verified',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('u',8,verified=False)],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),
 ('withdrawn',req(a=1,b=2),[ev('w',8,withdrawn=True)],P,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}),
]
for name,r,e,p,want in cases:
 before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); got=evaluate(r,e,p); assert got==want,(name,got,want); assert (r,e,p)==before,name
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: es=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,es,p) for r in rs]
print('ok',len(cases),'cases; report current')
